name: Via Francigena France 02, Arras - Reims
description_md:
Via Francigena France 02, Arras - Reims is a 228.5 km waymarked hiking route in France. The trail involves 2147 m of ascent and 2122 m of descent.

The route is signposted as GR 145 and belongs to the international waymarked hiking network. Walking this hard trail takes about 63 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, based on distance and ascent. The line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. The path passes Reims Cathedral within 100 m, and passes the Battle of Reims and Reims within 1000 m.
